title: Proposal: allow distinct application channels for the same underlying job
detail: Tim accepts applying through both employer and aggregator/recruiter paths for a strong opportunity where endpoints differ, and linking records later. Proposed identity model: one opportunity, multiple posting channels and separately evidenced applications; cross-channel possible matches nonblocking; protect rejected/applied history and never blindly replay Writer UNKNOWN outcomes.
blocks: Existing duplicate hard gates may suppress legitimate posting channels or stall intake.
options: Approve design review and scoped implementation plan
Approve policy wording only; defer engineering
recommended: Approve scoped design review before any dedup gate or Writer changes.
action: Tim chooses scope; only then authorize a named builder. No implementation from this proposal.
